tools.name: guild_wait_for_session
tools.description: Observe the root task with the session and send receipt. Repeat only the read-only wait when incomplete; never resend input.

tools.name: guild_get_session
tools.description: Get a session: its agent, status and when it last changed.

tools.name: guild_get_session_events
tools.description: Get a session's events, newest first.

tools.name: guild_whoami
tools.description: Who the connected user is, through which client, with which scopes.

tools.name: guild_send_session_message
tools.description: Send a message to a session as the user. Message consumption is unconfirmed.

tools.name: guild_start_profile_agent_test_session
tools.description: Start an exact-version test under a required gateway profile.
